column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. “Sons of gods” is rendered “sons of the mighty.”
NASB supplies “due” in “the glory due to His name”; “bow down” is rendered “Worship,” and “in adornment of holiness” as “in holy array.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with strength” is rendered “is powerful,” and “with majesty” as “is majestic.”
Close to the Hebrew; “causes the does to writhe” is rendered “makes the deer to calve.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “as King” in the first line.
